# Dilemma v3.6.0

Dilemma can publish a complete player guide in Polish or English and refresh that same message after an update. Private quiz panels now include Place bet and Go to quiz, making it easier to act on a saved answer and return to the original card.

- Publish `/dilemma guide` as one public text embed with a Refresh button. Publishing and refreshing require Manage Server or the configured Dilemma manager role. Refresh loads the running bot version's guide in the current server language, without creating another public message or role ping. Access and publication failures stay private.
- Keep both player guides below 4000 characters, use bold section titles and review their mechanics, labels, prices, rewards, limits and permissions before every release. Synchronize the saved documents and test the public/private interaction boundaries.
- Place a 1-20-Spark bet from the private answer panel. The form targets the original quiz, and submission updates the same panel with the stake and possible payout. Disable betting before a vote or when a bet is active; retain one-time charging and closed-quiz checks.
- Return directly to the original quiz message with Go to quiz from private answer, 50/50 and result panels. Opening the link spends no Sparks and sends no additional bot response.
- Show the remaining random cooldown in hours and minutes, rounded up to the next minute. Keep the six-hour cooldown and shared daily quota unchanged.
- End quiz artwork at the lavender frame with transparency outside it, preserving all four rounded corners. Document the bot's runtime images and local preview tools.
- Support only English and Polish throughout onboarding, command choices, generation, feedback, results and difficulty labels. Unsupported saved languages fall back to English; stale unsupported selections cannot overwrite settings. Previously published quiz history stays intact.
- Rename the Polish My answer button to "Moja odpowiedź" and retain "Mój wynik" after closing.

Re-register Discord commands when upgrading from v3.5.0. No database migration is required. Existing guide messages can be refreshed after the updated bot is running; existing quiz image attachments are not redrawn automatically.

The previously deferred general cleanup of action-confirmation messages is not part of this release.
